detaileddescription.para: Input and output buffers' order is defined by input_names and output_names respectively. If the latters are omitted, input and output buffers must be given in the order defined by the onnx model.
Input/output shapes of the buffers are optional as they are read in the onnx file. If a shape contains variable dimensions (represented by -1), the argument is required.
